question: Aktivitas pertama tiap rep pada tahun ini.

question: demo paling baru untuk masing2 pelanggan

question: Tiga deal terbesar per tahun pembuatan, tampilkan tahunnya.

question: Tampilkan deal terakhir tiap sales beserta nama sales dan timnya.

question: aktivitas terakhir tiap pelanggan + nama pelanggan dan nama rep yg handle
sql: SELECT x.activity_id, x.customer_id, x.rep_id, x.type, x.timestamp, x.customer_name, x.rep_name FROM (SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id AS customer_id, a.rep_id AS rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp, c.name AS customer_name, r.name AS rep_name, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY a.customer_id ORDER BY a.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id) AS x WHERE x.rn = 1

question: Untuk setiap pelanggan, tampilkan tiket urgent paling awal beserta nama pelanggannya.

question: deal won pertama tiap pelanggan Mid-Market, tampil nama pelanggan dan nilai deal

question: Per tim, tampilkan sales yang paling awal memenangkan deal beserta tanggal closing-nya.

question: tampilkan tiap deal beserta nilai deal pertama dari sales yg sama (urut tgl dibuat)

question: Tampilkan setiap aktivitas beserta waktu aktivitas terakhir pelanggan yang sama.

question: tiap tiket + prioritas tiket pertama dari pelanggan yg sama

question: Hitung selisih nilai tiap deal won dengan deal won pertama sales yang sama, mulai dari deal won ke-2.
sql: SELECT x.deal_id, x.title, x.stage, x.value, x.rep_id, x.closed_date, x.selisih_dari_pertama FROM (SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.rep_id, d.closed_date, d.value - first_value(d.value) OVER (PARTITION BY d.rep_id ORDER BY d.closed_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS selisih_dari_pertama, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY d.rep_id ORDER BY d.closed_date) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won') AS x WHERE x.rn > 1

question: berapa hari sejak aktivitas pertama tiap pelanggan sampai tiap aktivitas berikutnya? yg lebih dari 365 hari

question: Tampilkan tiap tiket dan selisih jamnya dengan tiket paling baru dari pelanggan yang sama, urut dari yg paling beda.

question: nilai deal pertama secara keseluruhan (urut tgl dibuat) di samping tiap deal won

question: Tampilkan setiap pelanggan beserta tanggal daftar pelanggan pertama di segmen yang sama.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment, first_value(c.created_at) OVER (PARTITION BY c.segment ORDER BY c.created_at ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS daftar_pertama_segmen FROM customers AS c FINAL

question: pertumbuhan omset bulanan dibanding bulan lalu (selisih rupiah)
sql: SELECT x.bulan, x.omset, x.omset_bulan_lalu, x.omset - x.omset_bulan_lalu AS selisih_omset FROM (SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS omset, lagInFrame(sum(d.value)) OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS omset_bulan_lalu, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY bulan) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 ORDER BY x.bulan

question: Hitung pertumbuhan omset per bulan terhadap bulan sebelumnya dalam rasio, 12 bulan terakhir.
sql: SELECT x.bulan, x.omset, x.omset_bulan_lalu, round((x.omset - x.omset_bulan_lalu) / x.omset_bulan_lalu, 2) AS pertumbuhan FROM (SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS omset, lagInFrame(sum(d.value)) OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS omset_bulan_lalu, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= subtractMonths(now(), 12) GROUP BY bulan) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 ORDER BY x.bulan

question: bulan apa aja omset naik dibanding bulan sebelumnya?
sql: SELECT x.bulan, x.omset, x.omset_bulan_lalu, x.omset - x.omset_bulan_lalu AS kenaikan FROM (SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS omset, lagInFrame(sum(d.value)) OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS omset_bulan_lalu, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY bulan) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 AND x.omset > x.omset_bulan_lalu ORDER BY x.bulan

question: Bulan mana saja jumlah tiket baru lebih sedikit daripada bulan sebelumnya?
sql: SELECT x.bulan, x.jumlah_tiket, x.tiket_bulan_lalu, x.jumlah_tiket - x.tiket_bulan_lalu AS selisih_tiket FROM (SELECT toStartOfMonth(t.created_at) AS bulan, count() AS jumlah_tiket, lagInFrame(count()) OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS tiket_bulan_lalu, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS rn FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY bulan) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 AND x.jumlah_tiket < x.tiket_bulan_lalu ORDER BY x.bulan

question: rekap jumlah aktivitas per minggu + selisih dgn minggu lalu, 3 bulan terakhir
sql: SELECT x.minggu, x.jumlah_aktivitas, x.aktivitas_minggu_lalu, x.jumlah_aktivitas - x.aktivitas_minggu_lalu AS selisih_aktivitas FROM (SELECT toStartOfWeek(a.timestamp, 1) AS minggu, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas, lagInFrame(count()) OVER (ORDER BY minggu) AS aktivitas_minggu_lalu, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY minggu) AS rn FROM activities AS a WHERE a.timestamp >= subtractMonths(now(), 3) GROUP BY minggu) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 ORDER BY x.minggu

question: Tampilkan jumlah pelanggan baru per bulan dan persentase pertumbuhan dibanding bulan sebelumnya.
sql: SELECT x.bulan, x.pelanggan_baru, x.pelanggan_baru_bulan_lalu, round((x.pelanggan_baru - x.pelanggan_baru_bulan_lalu) / x.pelanggan_baru_bulan_lalu, 2) AS pertumbuhan FROM (SELECT toStartOfMonth(c.created_at) AS bulan, count() AS pelanggan_baru, lagInFrame(count()) OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS pelanggan_baru_bulan_lalu, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS rn FROM customers AS c FINAL GROUP BY bulan) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 ORDER BY x.bulan

question: avg waktu resolusi tiket per bulan, bandingin sama bulan sebelumnya
sql: SELECT x.bulan, x.rata_rata_resolusi, x.rata_rata_bulan_lalu, x.rata_rata_resolusi - x.rata_rata_bulan_lalu AS selisih_resolusi FROM (SELECT toStartOfMonth(t.created_at) AS bulan, round(avg(t.resolution_time_hours), 2) AS rata_rata_resolusi, lagInFrame(round(avg(t.resolution_time_hours), 2)) OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS rata_rata_bulan_lalu, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS rn FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.status = 'resolved' GROUP BY bulan) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 ORDER BY x.bulan

question: Rata-rata durasi aktivitas per minggu dan perubahannya dari minggu sebelumnya, 8 minggu terakhir.
sql: SELECT x.minggu, x.rata_rata_durasi, x.durasi_minggu_lalu, x.rata_rata_durasi - x.durasi_minggu_lalu AS perubahan_durasi FROM (SELECT toStartOfWeek(a.timestamp, 1) AS minggu, round(avg(a.duration_minutes), 2) AS rata_rata_durasi, lagInFrame(round(avg(a.duration_minutes), 2)) OVER (ORDER BY minggu) AS durasi_minggu_lalu, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY minggu) AS rn FROM activities AS a WHERE a.timestamp >= subtractWeeks(now(), 8) GROUP BY minggu) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 ORDER BY x.minggu

question: Nilai pipeline baru (deal dibuat) per kuartal dan selisihnya dari kuartal sebelumnya.
sql: SELECT x.kuartal, x.nilai_deal_baru, x.nilai_kuartal_lalu, x.nilai_deal_baru - x.nilai_kuartal_lalu AS selisih_nilai FROM (SELECT toStartOfQuarter(d.created_date) AS kuartal, sum(d.value) AS nilai_deal_baru, lagInFrame(sum(d.value)) OVER (ORDER BY kuartal) AS nilai_kuartal_lalu, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY kuartal) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY kuartal) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 ORDER BY x.kuartal

question: omset tahunan vs tahun sebelumnya, naik brp?
sql: SELECT x.tahun, x.omset, x.omset_tahun_lalu, x.omset - x.omset_tahun_lalu AS selisih_omset FROM (SELECT toYear(d.closed_date) AS tahun, sum(d.value) AS omset, lagInFrame(sum(d.value)) OVER (ORDER BY tahun) AS omset_tahun_lalu, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY tahun) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY tahun) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 ORDER BY x.tahun

question: Jumlah deal lost per bulan dan pertumbuhannya dibanding bulan sebelumnya, tampilkan yang naik lebih dari 20%.
sql: SELECT x.bulan, x.jumlah_lost, x.lost_bulan_lalu, round((x.jumlah_lost - x.lost_bulan_lalu) / x.lost_bulan_lalu, 2) AS pertumbuhan FROM (SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, count() AS jumlah_lost, lagInFrame(count()) OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS lost_bulan_lalu, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'lost' GROUP BY bulan) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 AND x.jumlah_lost > x.lost_bulan_lalu * 1.2 ORDER BY x.bulan

question: Total durasi meeting per bulan dan pertumbuhannya dari bulan lalu.
sql: SELECT x.bulan, x.total_durasi, x.durasi_bulan_lalu, round((x.total_durasi - x.durasi_bulan_lalu) / x.durasi_bulan_lalu, 2) AS pertumbuhan FROM (SELECT toStartOfMonth(a.timestamp) AS bulan, sum(a.duration_minutes) AS total_durasi, lagInFrame(sum(a.duration_minutes)) OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS durasi_bulan_lalu, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS rn FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type = 'meeting' GROUP BY bulan) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 ORDER BY x.bulan

question: jumlah tiket urgent per minggu 6 bulan terakhir, selisih dgn minggu sebelumnya, urut minggu terbaru dulu
sql: SELECT x.minggu, x.jumlah_tiket, x.tiket_minggu_lalu, x.jumlah_tiket - x.tiket_minggu_lalu AS selisih_tiket FROM (SELECT toStartOfWeek(t.created_at, 1) AS minggu, count() AS jumlah_tiket, lagInFrame(count()) OVER (ORDER BY minggu) AS tiket_minggu_lalu, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY minggu) AS rn FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' AND t.created_at >= subtractMonths(now(), 6) GROUP BY minggu) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 ORDER BY x.minggu DESC

question: Selisih jumlah deal won tiap bulan dengan dua bulan sebelumnya.
sql: SELECT x.bulan, x.jumlah_won, x.jumlah_won_dua_bulan_lalu, x.jumlah_won - x.jumlah_won_dua_bulan_lalu AS selisih_dua_bulan FROM (SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, count() AS jumlah_won, lagInFrame(count(), 2) OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS jumlah_won_dua_bulan_lalu, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY bulan) AS x WHERE x.rn > 2 ORDER BY x.bulan

question: omset per bulan dibandingkan dgn bulan yg sama tahun lalu (selisih)
sql: SELECT x.bulan, x.omset, x.omset_tahun_lalu, x.omset - x.omset_tahun_lalu AS selisih_yoy FROM (SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS omset, lagInFrame(sum(d.value), 12) OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS omset_tahun_lalu, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY bulan) AS x WHERE x.rn > 12 ORDER BY x.bulan

question: Win rate per kuartal dan perubahannya dibanding kuartal sebelumnya.
sql: SELECT x.kuartal, x.win_rate, x.win_rate_kuartal_lalu, x.win_rate - x.win_rate_kuartal_lalu AS perubahan_win_rate FROM (SELECT toStartOfQuarter(d.closed_date) AS kuartal, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS win_rate, lagInFrame(round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2)) OVER (ORDER BY kuartal) AS win_rate_kuartal_lalu, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY kuartal) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY kuartal) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 ORDER BY x.kuartal

question: Pelanggan unik yang punya aktivitas per bulan dan selisih dengan bulan sebelumnya.
sql: SELECT x.bulan, x.pelanggan_unik, x.pelanggan_bulan_lalu, x.pelanggan_unik - x.pelanggan_bulan_lalu AS selisih_pelanggan FROM (SELECT toStartOfMonth(a.timestamp) AS bulan, uniqExact(a.customer_id) AS pelanggan_unik, lagInFrame(uniqExact(a.customer_id)) OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS pelanggan_bulan_lalu, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS rn FROM activities AS a GROUP BY bulan) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 ORDER BY x.bulan

question: harian: jumlah tiket 14 hari terakhir dan beda sama hari sebelumnya

question: Jumlah aktivitas per hari dalam 10 hari terakhir dan selisih dengan hari sebelumnya.
sql: SELECT x.tanggal, x.jumlah_aktivitas, x.aktivitas_hari_sebelumnya, x.jumlah_aktivitas - x.aktivitas_hari_sebelumnya AS selisih_aktivitas FROM (SELECT toDate(a.timestamp) AS tanggal, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas, lagInFrame(count()) OVER (ORDER BY tanggal) AS aktivitas_hari_sebelumnya, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY tanggal) AS rn FROM activities AS a WHERE a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 10) GROUP BY tanggal) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 ORDER BY x.tanggal

question: persentase perubahan jumlah deal baru per minggu 12 minggu terakhir

question: omset per bulan tahun ini + selisih vs bulan lalu

question: jumlah tiket per bulan tahun ini dan selisihnya dengan bulan sebelumnya

question: Rekap pelanggan baru per kuartal tahun ini dan selisih dari kuartal sebelumnya.

question: jumlah demo per bulan dan beda dgn bulan sblmnya

question: omset bulanan per tim sales dan selisihnya dari bulan sebelumnya
sql: SELECT x.team, x.bulan, x.omset, x.omset_bulan_lalu, x.omset - x.omset_bulan_lalu AS selisih_omset FROM (SELECT r.team, toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS omset, lagInFrame(sum(d.value)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.team ORDER BY bulan) AS omset_bulan_lalu, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY r.team ORDER BY bulan) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.team, bulan) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 ORDER BY x.team, x.bulan

question: Hitung pertumbuhan omset per bulan untuk setiap wilayah sales (rasio terhadap bulan sebelumnya).
sql: SELECT x.region, x.bulan, x.omset, x.omset_bulan_lalu, round((x.omset - x.omset_bulan_lalu) / x.omset_bulan_lalu, 2) AS pertumbuhan FROM (SELECT r.region, toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS omset, lagInFrame(sum(d.value)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region ORDER BY bulan) AS omset_bulan_lalu, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region ORDER BY bulan) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.region, bulan) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 ORDER BY x.region, x.bulan

question: per segmen pelanggan, omset per kuartal dan selisih dgn kuartal sebelumnya
sql: SELECT x.segment, x.kuartal, x.omset, x.omset_kuartal_lalu, x.omset - x.omset_kuartal_lalu AS selisih_omset FROM (SELECT c.segment, toStartOfQuarter(d.closed_date) AS kuartal, sum(d.value) AS omset, lagInFrame(sum(d.value)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.segment ORDER BY kuartal) AS omset_kuartal_lalu, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.segment ORDER BY kuartal) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY c.segment, kuartal) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 ORDER BY x.segment, x.kuartal

question: Tampilkan per sales: jumlah deal won tiap bulan dan selisihnya dengan bulan sebelumnya, hanya yang naik.
sql: SELECT x.rep_id, x.name, x.bulan, x.jumlah_won, x.won_bulan_lalu, x.jumlah_won - x.won_bulan_lalu AS selisih_won FROM (SELECT r.rep_id AS rep_id, r.name AS name, toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, count() AS jumlah_won, lagInFrame(count()) OVER (PARTITION BY rep_id, name ORDER BY bulan) AS won_bulan_lalu, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY rep_id, name ORDER BY bulan) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY rep_id, name, bulan) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 AND x.jumlah_won > x.won_bulan_lalu ORDER BY x.rep_id, x.name, x.bulan

question: jumlah aktivitas per minggu tiap rep dan selisih dgn minggu lalu, 2 bulan terakhir
sql: SELECT x.rep_id, x.name, x.minggu, x.jumlah_aktivitas, x.aktivitas_minggu_lalu, x.jumlah_aktivitas - x.aktivitas_minggu_lalu AS selisih_aktivitas FROM (SELECT r.rep_id AS rep_id, r.name AS name, toStartOfWeek(a.timestamp, 1) AS minggu, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas, lagInFrame(count()) OVER (PARTITION BY rep_id, name ORDER BY minggu) AS aktivitas_minggu_lalu, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY rep_id, name ORDER BY minggu) AS rn FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE a.timestamp >= subtractMonths(now(), 2) GROUP BY rep_id, name, minggu) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 ORDER BY x.rep_id, x.name, x.minggu

question: Jumlah tiket per bulan untuk tiap segmen pelanggan beserta selisih dari bulan sebelumnya.
sql: SELECT x.segment, x.bulan, x.jumlah_tiket, x.tiket_bulan_lalu, x.jumlah_tiket - x.tiket_bulan_lalu AS selisih_tiket FROM (SELECT c.segment, toStartOfMonth(t.created_at) AS bulan, count() AS jumlah_tiket, lagInFrame(count()) OVER (PARTITION BY c.segment ORDER BY bulan) AS tiket_bulan_lalu, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.segment ORDER BY bulan) AS rn FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment, bulan) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 ORDER BY x.segment, x.bulan

question: week-over-week jumlah aktivitas tiap tim (rasio perubahan), 10 minggu terakhir
sql: SELECT x.team, x.minggu, x.jumlah_aktivitas, x.aktivitas_minggu_lalu, round((x.jumlah_aktivitas - x.aktivitas_minggu_lalu) / x.aktivitas_minggu_lalu, 2) AS pertumbuhan FROM (SELECT r.team, toStartOfWeek(a.timestamp, 1) AS minggu, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas, lagInFrame(count()) OVER (PARTITION BY r.team ORDER BY minggu) AS aktivitas_minggu_lalu, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY r.team ORDER BY minggu) AS rn FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE a.timestamp >= subtractWeeks(now(), 10) GROUP BY r.team, minggu) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 ORDER BY x.team, x.minggu

question: Pelanggan baru per bulan per wilayah pelanggan, dan selisihnya dengan bulan sebelumnya.
sql: SELECT x.wilayah, x.bulan, x.pelanggan_baru, x.pelanggan_bulan_lalu, x.pelanggan_baru - x.pelanggan_bulan_lalu AS selisih_pelanggan FROM (SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS wilayah, toStartOfMonth(c.created_at) AS bulan, count() AS pelanggan_baru, lagInFrame(count()) OVER (PARTITION BY wilayah ORDER BY bulan) AS pelanggan_bulan_lalu, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY wilayah ORDER BY bulan) AS rn FROM customers AS c FINAL GROUP BY wilayah, bulan) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 ORDER BY x.wilayah, x.bulan

question: omset per bulan tiap sales, tampilkan yg turun lebih dari 1 juta dari bulan sebelumnya
sql: SELECT x.rep_id, x.name, x.bulan, x.omset, x.omset_bulan_lalu, x.omset - x.omset_bulan_lalu AS selisih_omset FROM (SELECT r.rep_id AS rep_id, r.name AS name, toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS omset, lagInFrame(sum(d.value)) OVER (PARTITION BY rep_id, name ORDER BY bulan) AS omset_bulan_lalu, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY rep_id, name ORDER BY bulan) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY rep_id, name, bulan) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 AND x.omset < x.omset_bulan_lalu - 1000000 ORDER BY x.rep_id, x.name, x.bulan

question: rata-rata resolusi tiket per prioritas tiap bulan dan perubahannya dari bulan lalu
sql: SELECT x.priority, x.bulan, x.rata_rata_resolusi, x.resolusi_bulan_lalu, x.rata_rata_resolusi - x.resolusi_bulan_lalu AS perubahan_resolusi FROM (SELECT t.priority, toStartOfMonth(t.created_at) AS bulan, round(avg(t.resolution_time_hours), 2) AS rata_rata_resolusi, lagInFrame(round(avg(t.resolution_time_hours), 2)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.priority ORDER BY bulan) AS resolusi_bulan_lalu, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY t.priority ORDER BY bulan) AS rn FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.status = 'resolved' GROUP BY t.priority, bulan) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 ORDER BY x.priority, x.bulan

question: Nilai deal baru per kuartal tiap tim sales dan persentase perubahannya dari kuartal sebelumnya.
sql: SELECT x.team, x.kuartal, x.nilai_deal_baru, x.nilai_kuartal_lalu, round((x.nilai_deal_baru - x.nilai_kuartal_lalu) / x.nilai_kuartal_lalu, 2) AS pertumbuhan FROM (SELECT r.team, toStartOfQuarter(d.created_date) AS kuartal, sum(d.value) AS nilai_deal_baru, lagInFrame(sum(d.value)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.team ORDER BY kuartal) AS nilai_kuartal_lalu, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY r.team ORDER BY kuartal) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.team, kuartal) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 ORDER BY x.team, x.kuartal

question: durasi rata2 aktivitas per bulan utk tiap tipe aktivitas, bandingin dgn bulan lalu
sql: SELECT x.type, x.bulan, x.rata_rata_durasi, x.durasi_bulan_lalu, x.rata_rata_durasi - x.durasi_bulan_lalu AS selisih_durasi FROM (SELECT a.type, toStartOfMonth(a.timestamp) AS bulan, round(avg(a.duration_minutes), 2) AS rata_rata_durasi, lagInFrame(round(avg(a.duration_minutes), 2)) OVER (PARTITION BY a.type ORDER BY bulan) AS durasi_bulan_lalu, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY a.type ORDER BY bulan) AS rn FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.type, bulan) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 ORDER BY x.type, x.bulan

question: Win rate per bulan untuk tiap tim dan selisihnya dibanding bulan sebelumnya, 12 bulan terakhir.
sql: SELECT x.team, x.bulan, x.win_rate, x.win_rate_bulan_lalu, x.win_rate - x.win_rate_bulan_lalu AS perubahan_win_rate FROM (SELECT r.team, toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS win_rate, lagInFrame(round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.team ORDER BY bulan) AS win_rate_bulan_lalu, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY r.team ORDER BY bulan) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.closed_date >= subtractMonths(now(), 12) GROUP BY r.team, bulan) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 ORDER BY x.team, x.bulan

question: omset per bulan per segmen customer dan tim sales, bandingkan dgn bulan sebelumnya
sql: SELECT x.segment, x.team, x.bulan, x.omset, x.omset_bulan_lalu, x.omset - x.omset_bulan_lalu AS selisih_omset FROM (SELECT c.segment, r.team, toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS omset, lagInFrame(sum(d.value)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.segment, r.team ORDER BY bulan) AS omset_bulan_lalu, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.segment, r.team ORDER BY bulan) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY c.segment, r.team, bulan) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 ORDER BY x.segment, x.team, x.bulan

question: Tiket urgent per minggu di tiap wilayah pelanggan beserta selisih dari minggu sebelumnya, 3 bulan terakhir.
sql: SELECT x.wilayah, x.minggu, x.jumlah_tiket, x.tiket_minggu_lalu, x.jumlah_tiket - x.tiket_minggu_lalu AS selisih_tiket FROM (SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS wilayah, toStartOfWeek(t.created_at, 1) AS minggu, count() AS jumlah_tiket, lagInFrame(count()) OVER (PARTITION BY wilayah ORDER BY minggu) AS tiket_minggu_lalu, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY wilayah ORDER BY minggu) AS rn FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' AND t.created_at >= subtractMonths(now(), 3) GROUP BY wilayah, minggu) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 ORDER BY x.wilayah, x.minggu

question: jumlah deal won per tahun per tim dan pertumbuhan thd tahun lalu
sql: SELECT x.team, x.tahun, x.jumlah_won, x.won_tahun_lalu, round((x.jumlah_won - x.won_tahun_lalu) / x.won_tahun_lalu, 2) AS pertumbuhan FROM (SELECT r.team, toYear(d.closed_date) AS tahun, count() AS jumlah_won, lagInFrame(count()) OVER (PARTITION BY r.team ORDER BY tahun) AS won_tahun_lalu, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY r.team ORDER BY tahun) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.team, tahun) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 ORDER BY x.team, x.tahun

question: Total durasi call per bulan untuk tiap rep dan selisihnya dengan bulan sebelumnya, tampilkan hanya yang naik.
sql: SELECT x.rep_id, x.name, x.bulan, x.total_durasi, x.durasi_bulan_lalu, x.total_durasi - x.durasi_bulan_lalu AS selisih_durasi FROM (SELECT r.rep_id AS rep_id, r.name AS name, toStartOfMonth(a.timestamp) AS bulan, sum(a.duration_minutes) AS total_durasi, lagInFrame(sum(a.duration_minutes)) OVER (PARTITION BY rep_id, name ORDER BY bulan) AS durasi_bulan_lalu, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY rep_id, name ORDER BY bulan) AS rn FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE a.type = 'call' GROUP BY rep_id, name, bulan) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 AND x.total_durasi > x.durasi_bulan_lalu ORDER BY x.rep_id, x.name, x.bulan

question: omset bulanan per wilayah sales, tampilkan bulan2 dimana omset turun dibanding bulan sebelumnya beserta persen penurunannya
sql: SELECT x.region, x.bulan, x.omset, x.omset_bulan_lalu, round((x.omset - x.omset_bulan_lalu) / x.omset_bulan_lalu, 2) AS persen_perubahan FROM (SELECT r.region, toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS omset, lagInFrame(sum(d.value)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region ORDER BY bulan) AS omset_bulan_lalu, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region ORDER BY bulan) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.region, bulan) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 AND x.omset < x.omset_bulan_lalu ORDER BY x.region, x.bulan

question: pertumbuhan jumlah tiket resolved per kuartal dibanding kuartal sebelumnya
sql: SELECT x.kuartal, x.jumlah_resolved, x.resolved_kuartal_lalu, round((x.jumlah_resolved - x.resolved_kuartal_lalu) / x.resolved_kuartal_lalu, 2) AS pertumbuhan FROM (SELECT toStartOfQuarter(t.created_at) AS kuartal, count() AS jumlah_resolved, lagInFrame(count()) OVER (ORDER BY kuartal) AS resolved_kuartal_lalu, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY kuartal) AS rn FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.status = 'resolved' GROUP BY kuartal) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 ORDER BY x.kuartal

question: Rekap rata-rata nilai deal won per bulan, selisih dari bulan sebelumnya, 18 bulan terakhir.
sql: SELECT x.bulan, x.rata_rata_nilai, x.rata_rata_bulan_lalu, x.rata_rata_nilai - x.rata_rata_bulan_lalu AS selisih_rata_rata FROM (SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, round(avg(d.value), 2) AS rata_rata_nilai, lagInFrame(round(avg(d.value), 2)) OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS rata_rata_bulan_lalu, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= subtractMonths(now(), 18) GROUP BY bulan) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 ORDER BY x.bulan

question: Berapa pertumbuhan jumlah customer churn baru (daftar) per kuartal dibanding kuartal lalu?
sql: SELECT x.kuartal, x.jumlah_churn, x.churn_kuartal_lalu, round((x.jumlah_churn - x.churn_kuartal_lalu) / x.churn_kuartal_lalu, 2) AS pertumbuhan FROM (SELECT toStartOfQuarter(c.created_at) AS kuartal, count() AS jumlah_churn, lagInFrame(count()) OVER (ORDER BY kuartal) AS churn_kuartal_lalu, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY kuartal) AS rn FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'churned' GROUP BY kuartal) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 ORDER BY x.kuartal

question: minggu dengan jumlah aktivitas negatif lebih banyak dari minggu sebelumnya
sql: SELECT x.minggu, x.jumlah_negatif, x.negatif_minggu_lalu, x.jumlah_negatif - x.negatif_minggu_lalu AS selisih_negatif FROM (SELECT toStartOfWeek(a.timestamp, 1) AS minggu, count() AS jumlah_negatif, lagInFrame(count()) OVER (ORDER BY minggu) AS negatif_minggu_lalu, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY minggu) AS rn FROM activities AS a WHERE a.sentiment = 'negative' GROUP BY minggu) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 AND x.jumlah_negatif > x.negatif_minggu_lalu ORDER BY x.minggu

question: tampilkan tiap tiket beserta waktu tiket sebelumnya dari pelanggan yang sama
sql: SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at, lagInFrame(t.created_at) OVER (PARTITION BY t.customer_id ORDER BY t.created_at) AS waktu_tiket_sebelumnya FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL

question: deal + stage deal sebelumnya milik sales yg sama (urut tgl dibuat)

question: Tampilkan durasi tiap call dan durasi call sebelumnya oleh rep yang sama.
sql: SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp, a.duration_minutes, lagInFrame(a.duration_minutes) OVER (PARTITION BY a.rep_id ORDER BY a.timestamp) AS durasi_sebelumnya FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type = 'call'

question: nilai deal won sebelumnya (urut tgl closing) di samping tiap deal won, tanpa pengelompokan
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.closed_date, lagInFrame(d.value) OVER (ORDER BY d.closed_date) AS nilai_sebelumnya FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won'

question: Untuk tiap pelanggan, tampilkan tanggal daftar pelanggan yang daftar sebelumnya.

question: sentimen aktivitas sebelumnya utk tiap aktivitas, per pelanggan

question: Tampilkan prioritas tiket sebelumnya untuk setiap tiket high atau urgent per pelanggan.
sql: SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at, lagInFrame(t.priority) OVER (PARTITION BY t.customer_id ORDER BY t.created_at) AS prioritas_sebelumnya FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority IN ('high','urgent')

question: tiap deal + probability deal sebelumnya, per pelanggan
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.customer_id, d.probability, d.created_date, lagInFrame(d.probability) OVER (PARTITION BY d.customer_id ORDER BY d.created_date) AS probability_sebelumnya FROM deals AS d FINAL

question: Tampilkan resolution time tiap tiket resolved beserta resolution time tiket resolved sebelumnya (semua pelanggan).
sql: SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at, t.resolution_time_hours, lagInFrame(t.resolution_time_hours) OVER (ORDER BY t.created_at) AS waktu_sebelumnya FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.status = 'resolved' AND t.resolution_time_hours IS NOT NULL

question: tiap deal + nilai deal berikutnya dari pelanggan yg sama
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.customer_id, d.created_date, leadInFrame(d.value) OVER (PARTITION BY d.customer_id ORDER BY d.created_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS nilai_berikutnya FROM deals AS d FINAL

question: Tampilkan aktivitas beserta tipe aktivitas berikutnya pada pelanggan yang sama.
sql: SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp, leadInFrame(a.type) OVER (PARTITION BY a.customer_id ORDER BY a.timestamp ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS tipe_berikutnya FROM activities AS a

question: tiket + waktu tiket berikutnya dari pelanggan yang sama, hanya yang resolved
sql: SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at, leadInFrame(t.created_at) OVER (PARTITION BY t.customer_id ORDER BY t.created_at ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS waktu_tiket_berikutnya FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.status = 'resolved'

question: Tampilkan meeting dan waktu meeting berikutnya oleh rep yang sama.

question: deal lost + nilai deal lost berikutnya milik sales yg sama (urut tgl closing)
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.rep_id, d.closed_date, leadInFrame(d.value) OVER (PARTITION BY d.rep_id ORDER BY d.closed_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS nilai_berikutnya FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'lost'

question: pelanggan + tanggal daftar pelanggan berikutnya di segmen yang sama
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment, c.created_at, leadInFrame(c.created_at) OVER (PARTITION BY c.segment ORDER BY c.created_at ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS daftar_berikutnya FROM customers AS c FINAL

question: Tampilkan setiap demo dengan durasi demo berikutnya (urut waktu, semua rep).
sql: SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp, a.duration_minutes, leadInFrame(a.duration_minutes) OVER (ORDER BY a.timestamp ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS durasi_berikutnya FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type = 'demo'

question: tiap tiket urgent + selisih jam dgn tiket urgent sebelumnya
sql: SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at, dateDiff('hour', lagInFrame(t.created_at) OVER (ORDER BY t.created_at), t.created_at) AS selisih_jam FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent'

question: Tampilkan deal beserta selisih nilainya dengan deal sebelumnya dari sales yang sama.

question: selisih durasi tiap meeting dgn meeting sebelumnya per pelanggan
sql: SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp, a.duration_minutes, a.duration_minutes - lagInFrame(a.duration_minutes) OVER (PARTITION BY a.customer_id ORDER BY a.timestamp) AS selisih_durasi FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type = 'meeting'

question: Tampilkan tiap aktivitas dan jarak hari ke aktivitas berikutnya pada pelanggan yang sama.
sql: SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp, dateDiff('day', a.timestamp, leadInFrame(a.timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY a.customer_id ORDER BY a.timestamp ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING)) AS hari_ke_berikutnya FROM activities AS a

question: nilai deal tiap deal negotiation + nilai deal negotiation sebelumnya, tim yg sama
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.created_date, r.team AS team, lagInFrame(d.value) OVER (PARTITION BY r.team ORDER BY d.created_date) AS nilai_sebelumnya FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'negotiation'

question: Tampilkan call tiap rep beserta nama rep dan durasi call sebelumnya.
sql: SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp, a.duration_minutes, r.name AS rep_name, lagInFrame(a.duration_minutes) OVER (PARTITION BY a.rep_id ORDER BY a.timestamp) AS durasi_sebelumnya FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE a.type = 'call'

question: tiket + nama pelanggan + waktu tiket sebelumnya dari pelanggan itu
sql: SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at, c.name AS customer_name, lagInFrame(t.created_at) OVER (PARTITION BY t.customer_id ORDER BY t.created_at) AS waktu_tiket_sebelumnya FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id

question: Tampilkan deal won, nama sales, dan nilai deal won sebelumnya sales itu.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.closed_date, r.name AS rep_name, lagInFrame(d.value) OVER (PARTITION BY d.rep_id ORDER BY d.closed_date) AS nilai_sebelumnya FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won'

question: durasi aktivitas tiap rep dibanding aktivitas berikutnya rep itu, 30 hari terakhir
sql: SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp, a.duration_minutes, leadInFrame(a.duration_minutes) OVER (PARTITION BY a.rep_id ORDER BY a.timestamp ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS durasi_berikutnya FROM activities AS a WHERE a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 30)

question: Tampilkan pelanggan Enterprise beserta nama pelanggan Enterprise yang daftar sebelumnya.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment, c.created_at, lagInFrame(c.name) OVER (ORDER BY c.created_at) AS nama_pelanggan_sebelumnya FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.segment = 'Enterprise'

question: tiap deal + judul deal pertama dan terakhir dari sales yang sama (urut tgl dibuat)
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.rep_id, first_value(d.title) OVER (PARTITION BY d.rep_id ORDER BY d.created_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS deal_pertama, last_value(d.title) OVER (PARTITION BY d.rep_id ORDER BY d.created_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS deal_terakhir FROM deals AS d FINAL

question: Tampilkan setiap tiket beserta status tiket terakhir milik pelanggan yang sama.
sql: SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at, last_value(t.status) OVER (PARTITION BY t.customer_id ORDER BY t.created_at ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS status_tiket_terakhir FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL

question: kasih liat tiap aktivitas + tipe aktivitas pertama pelanggan itu
sql: SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp, first_value(a.type) OVER (PARTITION BY a.customer_id ORDER BY a.timestamp ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS tipe_aktivitas_pertama FROM activities AS a

question: Tampilkan setiap pelanggan beserta nama pelanggan terbaru di status yang sama.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment, last_value(c.name) OVER (PARTITION BY c.status ORDER BY c.created_at ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS pelanggan_terbaru_di_status FROM customers AS c FINAL

question: tiap deal won + selisih nilainya dgn deal won terbesar sales yg sama
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.rep_id, max(d.value) OVER (PARTITION BY d.rep_id) - d.value AS selisih_dari_terbesar FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won'

question: jumlah deal won per bulan beserta jumlah bulan sebelumnya
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, count() AS jumlah_won, lagInFrame(count()) OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS jumlah_bulan_lalu FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: Tampilkan jumlah tiket per minggu dan jumlah tiket minggu sebelumnya.
sql: SELECT toStartOfWeek(t.created_at, 1) AS minggu, count() AS jumlah_tiket, lagInFrame(count()) OVER (ORDER BY minggu) AS jumlah_minggu_lalu FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY minggu ORDER BY minggu

question: omset per kuartal dan omset kuartal berikutnya
sql: SELECT toStartOfQuarter(d.closed_date) AS kuartal, sum(d.value) AS omset, leadInFrame(sum(d.value)) OVER (ORDER BY kuartal ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS omset_kuartal_berikutnya FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY kuartal ORDER BY kuartal

question: Rekap rata-rata durasi aktivitas per bulan beserta rata-rata bulan sebelumnya.
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(a.timestamp) AS bulan, round(avg(a.duration_minutes), 2) AS rata_rata_durasi, lagInFrame(round(avg(a.duration_minutes), 2)) OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS durasi_bulan_lalu FROM activities AS a GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: pelanggan baru per tahun dan tahun sebelumnya
sql: SELECT toYear(c.created_at) AS tahun, count() AS pelanggan_baru, lagInFrame(count()) OVER (ORDER BY tahun) AS pelanggan_tahun_lalu FROM customers AS c FINAL GROUP BY tahun ORDER BY tahun

question: jumlah aktivitas per hari 7 hari terakhir + jumlah kemarinnya
sql: SELECT toDate(a.timestamp) AS tanggal, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas, lagInFrame(count()) OVER (ORDER BY tanggal) AS jumlah_hari_sebelumnya FROM activities AS a WHERE a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 7) GROUP BY tanggal ORDER BY tanggal

question: Tampilkan nilai deal baru per bulan tahun ini, plus nilai bulan sebelumnya dan bulan berikutnya.
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.created_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS nilai_deal_baru, lagInFrame(sum(d.value)) OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS nilai_bulan_lalu, leadInFrame(sum(d.value)) OVER (ORDER BY bulan ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS nilai_bulan_depan FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.created_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: bulan mana yang kenaikan omsetnya paling besar dibanding bulan sebelumnya?
sql: SELECT x.bulan, x.omset, x.omset_bulan_lalu, x.omset - x.omset_bulan_lalu AS kenaikan FROM (SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS omset, lagInFrame(sum(d.value)) OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS omset_bulan_lalu, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY bulan) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 ORDER BY kenaikan DESC LIMIT 1

question: Tampilkan 3 bulan dengan penurunan omset terbesar dibanding bulan sebelumnya.
sql: SELECT x.bulan, x.omset, x.omset_bulan_lalu, x.omset - x.omset_bulan_lalu AS selisih_omset FROM (SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS omset, lagInFrame(sum(d.value)) OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS omset_bulan_lalu, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY bulan) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 ORDER BY selisih_omset ASC LIMIT 3

question: berapa hari dari deal pertama ke deal kedua tiap pelanggan? tampilkan nama pelanggan
sql: SELECT x.customer_id, x.name, x.jarak_hari FROM (SELECT c.customer_id AS customer_id, c.name AS name, dateDiff('day', lagInFrame(d.created_date) OVER (PARTITION BY d.customer_id ORDER BY d.created_date), d.created_date) AS jarak_hari, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY d.customer_id ORDER BY d.created_date) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id) AS x WHERE x.rn = 2

question: Tiket high yang merupakan tiket ketiga berturut-turut berprioritas high dari pelanggan yang sama.
sql: SELECT x.ticket_id, x.customer_id, x.priority, x.status, x.created_at FROM (SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at, lagInFrame(t.priority, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY t.customer_id ORDER BY t.created_at) AS prioritas_1, lagInFrame(t.priority, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY t.customer_id ORDER BY t.created_at) AS prioritas_2, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY t.customer_id ORDER BY t.created_at) AS rn FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL) AS x WHERE x.rn > 2 AND x.priority = 'high' AND x.prioritas_1 = 'high' AND x.prioritas_2 = 'high'

question: pelanggan mana yg deal terakhirnya bernilai lebih tinggi dari deal sebelumnya? tampilkan nilai kedua deal itu
sql: SELECT x.customer_id, x.name, x.value AS nilai_deal_terakhir, x.nilai_sebelumnya FROM (SELECT c.customer_id AS customer_id, c.name AS name, d.value AS value, lagInFrame(d.value) OVER (PARTITION BY d.customer_id ORDER BY d.created_date) AS nilai_sebelumnya, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY d.customer_id ORDER BY d.created_date) AS rn, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY d.customer_id ORDER BY d.created_date DESC) AS rn_akhir FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 AND x.rn_akhir = 1 AND x.value > x.nilai_sebelumnya

question: Hitung jumlah call per rep yang durasinya lebih lama dari call sebelumnya rep itu.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, countIf(g.durasi > g.durasi_sebelumnya) AS jumlah_call_naik FROM (SELECT a.rep_id AS rep_id, a.duration_minutes AS durasi, lagInFrame(a.duration_minutes) OVER (PARTITION BY a.rep_id ORDER BY a.timestamp) AS durasi_sebelumnya, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY a.rep_id ORDER BY a.timestamp) AS rn FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type = 'call') AS g INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON g.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE g.rn > 1 GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY jumlah_call_naik DESC

question: per tim, berapa kali deal won lebih besar dari deal won sebelumnya (urut tgl closing, dlm tim yg sama)?
sql: SELECT g.team, countIf(g.nilai > g.nilai_sebelumnya) AS jumlah_naik FROM (SELECT r.team AS team, d.value AS nilai, lagInFrame(d.value) OVER (PARTITION BY r.team ORDER BY d.closed_date) AS nilai_sebelumnya, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY r.team ORDER BY d.closed_date) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won') AS g WHERE g.rn > 1 GROUP BY g.team ORDER BY g.team

question: Pelanggan yang punya jeda lebih dari 90 hari antar aktivitas, hitung berapa kali jeda itu terjadi, tampilkan nama pelanggan.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, countIf(g.jarak_hari > 90) AS jumlah_jeda_panjang FROM (SELECT a.customer_id AS customer_id, dateDiff('day', lagInFrame(a.timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY a.customer_id ORDER BY a.timestamp), a.timestamp) AS jarak_hari, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY a.customer_id ORDER BY a.timestamp) AS rn FROM activities AS a) AS g INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON g.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE g.rn > 1 GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING countIf(g.jarak_hari > 90) > 0 ORDER BY jumlah_jeda_panjang DESC

question: kuartal dengan pertumbuhan jumlah deal won tertinggi dibanding kuartal sebelumnya (persen)
sql: SELECT x.kuartal, x.jumlah_won, x.won_kuartal_lalu, round((x.jumlah_won - x.won_kuartal_lalu) / x.won_kuartal_lalu, 2) AS pertumbuhan FROM (SELECT toStartOfQuarter(d.closed_date) AS kuartal, count() AS jumlah_won, lagInFrame(count()) OVER (ORDER BY kuartal) AS won_kuartal_lalu, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY kuartal) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY kuartal) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 ORDER BY pertumbuhan DESC LIMIT 1

question: Tiap sales: omset bulan ini dibanding bulan lalu, tampilkan sales yang omset bulan ini lebih rendah
sql: SELECT x.rep_id, x.name, x.omset, x.omset_bulan_lalu FROM (SELECT r.rep_id AS rep_id, r.name AS name, toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS omset, lagInFrame(sum(d.value)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY bulan) AS omset_bulan_lalu, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY bulan) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name, bulan) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 AND x.bulan = toStartOfMonth(today()) AND x.omset < x.omset_bulan_lalu

question: Jumlah tiket per bulan untuk tiap prioritas beserta jumlah bulan berikutnya, bulan paling akhir tiap prioritas tidak ditampilkan
sql: SELECT x.priority, x.bulan, x.jumlah_tiket, x.jumlah_bulan_berikutnya FROM (SELECT t.priority AS priority, toStartOfMonth(t.created_at) AS bulan, count() AS jumlah_tiket, leadInFrame(count()) OVER (PARTITION BY t.priority ORDER BY bulan ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS jumlah_bulan_berikutnya, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY t.priority ORDER BY bulan DESC) AS rn_akhir FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.priority, bulan) AS x WHERE x.rn_akhir > 1 ORDER BY x.priority, x.bulan

question: Pertumbuhan jumlah aktivitas bulanan tiap tipe aktivitas vs bulan lalu (rasio), hanya yg tumbuh lebih dari 10%
sql: SELECT x.type, x.bulan, x.jumlah_aktivitas, x.aktivitas_bulan_lalu, round((x.jumlah_aktivitas - x.aktivitas_bulan_lalu) / x.aktivitas_bulan_lalu, 2) AS pertumbuhan FROM (SELECT a.type AS type, toStartOfMonth(a.timestamp) AS bulan, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas, lagInFrame(count()) OVER (PARTITION BY a.type ORDER BY bulan) AS aktivitas_bulan_lalu, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY a.type ORDER BY bulan) AS rn FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.type, bulan) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 AND x.jumlah_aktivitas > x.aktivitas_bulan_lalu * 1.1 ORDER BY x.type, x.bulan

question: pelanggan baru per bulan per segmen, naik/turun dari bulan lalu, yg segmen SMB saja
sql: SELECT x.segment, x.bulan, x.pelanggan_baru, x.pelanggan_bulan_lalu, x.pelanggan_baru - x.pelanggan_bulan_lalu AS selisih_pelanggan FROM (SELECT c.segment AS segment, toStartOfMonth(c.created_at) AS bulan, count() AS pelanggan_baru, lagInFrame(count()) OVER (PARTITION BY c.segment ORDER BY bulan) AS pelanggan_bulan_lalu, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.segment ORDER BY bulan) AS rn FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.segment = 'SMB' GROUP BY c.segment, bulan) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 ORDER BY x.bulan

question: Siapa saja sales yang jumlah deal won-nya di bulan lalu naik dibanding sebulan sebelumnya? tampilkan kedua jumlahnya
sql: SELECT x.rep_id, x.name, x.jumlah_won, x.won_bulan_sebelumnya FROM (SELECT r.rep_id AS rep_id, r.name AS name, toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, count() AS jumlah_won, lagInFrame(count()) OVER (PARTITION BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY bulan) AS won_bulan_sebelumnya, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY bulan) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 2)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfMonth(today()) GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name, bulan) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 AND x.jumlah_won > x.won_bulan_sebelumnya

question: Tampilkan nilai dari dua deal sebelumnya milik pelanggan yang sama untuk tiap deal, mulai deal ketiga.
sql: SELECT x.deal_id, x.title, x.stage, x.value, x.customer_id, x.created_date, x.nilai_dua_deal_sebelumnya FROM (SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.customer_id, d.created_date, lagInFrame(d.value, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY d.customer_id ORDER BY d.created_date) AS nilai_dua_deal_sebelumnya, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY d.customer_id ORDER BY d.created_date) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL) AS x WHERE x.rn > 2

question: tiket yg dibuat di hari yg sama dgn tiket sebelumnya dari pelanggan itu
sql: SELECT x.ticket_id, x.customer_id, x.priority, x.status, x.created_at, x.waktu_tiket_sebelumnya FROM (SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at, lagInFrame(t.created_at) OVER (PARTITION BY t.customer_id ORDER BY t.created_at) AS waktu_tiket_sebelumnya, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY t.customer_id ORDER BY t.created_at) AS rn FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 AND toDate(x.created_at) = toDate(x.waktu_tiket_sebelumnya)

question: Cari aktivitas yg tipenya berubah dari aktivitas sebelumnya ke pelanggan yg sama, khusus yg sebelumnya email dan sekarang meeting
sql: SELECT x.activity_id, x.customer_id, x.rep_id, x.type, x.timestamp, x.tipe_sebelumnya FROM (SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp, lagInFrame(a.type) OVER (PARTITION BY a.customer_id ORDER BY a.timestamp) AS tipe_sebelumnya, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY a.customer_id ORDER BY a.timestamp) AS rn FROM activities AS a) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 AND x.tipe_sebelumnya = 'email' AND x.type = 'meeting'

question: deal won yg nilainya lebih dari 2x lipat deal won sebelumnya dari sales yg sama
sql: SELECT x.deal_id, x.title, x.stage, x.value, x.rep_id, x.closed_date, x.nilai_sebelumnya FROM (SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.rep_id, d.closed_date, lagInFrame(d.value) OVER (PARTITION BY d.rep_id ORDER BY d.closed_date) AS nilai_sebelumnya, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY d.rep_id ORDER BY d.closed_date) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won') AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 AND x.value > x.nilai_sebelumnya * 2

question: jarak hari antar deal lost berurutan oleh pelanggan yg sama, yg kurang dari 30 hari
sql: SELECT x.deal_id, x.title, x.stage, x.value, x.customer_id, x.closed_date, x.jarak_hari FROM (SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.customer_id, d.closed_date, dateDiff('day', lagInFrame(d.closed_date) OVER (PARTITION BY d.customer_id ORDER BY d.closed_date), d.closed_date) AS jarak_hari, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY d.customer_id ORDER BY d.closed_date) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'lost') AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 AND x.jarak_hari < 30

question: tiket resolved dgn resolution time lebih lama dari tiket berikutnya pelanggan yg sama (tiket berikutnya juga resolved)
sql: SELECT x.ticket_id, x.customer_id, x.priority, x.status, x.created_at, x.resolution_time_hours, x.waktu_berikutnya FROM (SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at, t.resolution_time_hours, leadInFrame(t.resolution_time_hours) OVER (PARTITION BY t.customer_id ORDER BY t.created_at ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS waktu_berikutnya, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY t.customer_id ORDER BY t.created_at DESC) AS rn_akhir FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.status = 'resolved' AND t.resolution_time_hours IS NOT NULL) AS x WHERE x.rn_akhir > 1 AND x.resolution_time_hours > x.waktu_berikutnya

question: Tampilkan deal proposal beserta probability deal proposal berikutnya dari sales yang sama, hanya yang berikutnya lebih rendah.
sql: SELECT x.deal_id, x.title, x.stage, x.value, x.rep_id, x.probability, x.probability_berikutnya FROM (SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.rep_id, d.probability, leadInFrame(d.probability) OVER (PARTITION BY d.rep_id ORDER BY d.created_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS probability_berikutnya, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY d.rep_id ORDER BY d.created_date DESC) AS rn_akhir FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'proposal') AS x WHERE x.rn_akhir > 1 AND x.probability_berikutnya < x.probability

question: aktivitas pertama tiap pelanggan Enterprise
sql: SELECT x.activity_id, x.customer_id, x.rep_id, x.type, x.timestamp FROM (SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY a.customer_id ORDER BY a.timestamp) AS rn FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.segment = 'Enterprise') AS x WHERE x.rn = 1

question: tiket terakhir tiap pelanggan yg masih open/in_progress
sql: SELECT x.ticket_id, x.customer_id, x.priority, x.status, x.created_at FROM (SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY t.customer_id ORDER BY t.created_at DESC) AS rn FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.status IN ('open','in_progress')) AS x WHERE x.rn = 1

question: Tampilkan tiket yang resolution time-nya sama atau lebih lama dari tiket sebelumnya pada prioritas yang sama (urut waktu dibuat), status resolved.
sql: SELECT x.ticket_id, x.customer_id, x.priority, x.status, x.created_at, x.resolution_time_hours, x.waktu_sebelumnya FROM (SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at, t.resolution_time_hours, lagInFrame(t.resolution_time_hours) OVER (PARTITION BY t.priority ORDER BY t.created_at) AS waktu_sebelumnya, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY t.priority ORDER BY t.created_at) AS rn FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.status = 'resolved' AND t.resolution_time_hours IS NOT NULL) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 AND x.resolution_time_hours >= x.waktu_sebelumnya
